" Builds 1000-1001:
  • 🎂the milestone 1000th build of Poweramp, celebrating 15 years of continuous development and support
  • default No DVC and No Headroom options for Other output (used for the wired Android Auto connection)
  • improved Strict Resume/Pause/Stop option
    Better handling of connections that rapidly send play/pause/stop commands
  • Poweramp suggests disabling Manage App If Unused option if detected
    As reported by out users, this setting may revoke file access not only after 60 days of inactivity but also after firmware updates, date changes, and other unexpected events
  • bug fixes and stability improvements
  • updated translations

"

" Builds 1002-1025:
  • bug fixes and stability improvements
  • customizable buttons row on the player screen
    • included in 🎁 Feature Pack #1
    • ✅ the top voted feature from the New Poweramp Features list
    • long press between buttons to enter edit mode or start it from the settings
    • 20+ buttons, such as track menu and track actions, cast, audio info, etc. are available
    • the classic centered layout - buttons will try to fit around the centered slot
    • the plain layout - buttons placed in a compact row
    • normal or small button sizes are available
    • one row or two rows
    • buttons can be scrolled
    • buttons and layout settings are independent for portrait and landscape due to the varying available space in these orientations
    • Prefer No Gap option
    • Do Not Edit On Long Press option
  • new Player Buttons Background option for the built-in skins
  • the skin option Label Background doesn't change screen background anymore
  • new Resume On Focus option
  • new Stream Name In Title option
  • new Animate Long Labels Everywhere option
  • new Dark Skin Transparent Status Bar option
  • repeat mode improvements
    • ✅ another voted feature from the New Poweramp Features list
    • added new Play All Categories mode, which plays all categories and stops
    • added hints to shuffle/repeat popups
    • updated wording for repeat modes/hints
  • AutoEq presets/devices database update
    17703 presets updated
  • improved album art handling for streams with very long uris
  • workaround for the headset/headunit/BT key presses intercepted and modified by Gemini
  • updated translations

"

" Builds 1026-10xx:
  • major Audio Engine update:
    • ✅ the top voted feature from the New Poweramp Features list
    • USB Exclusive Driver: direct access to the attached USB DAC bypassing Android audio, supporting PCM 44.1-768kHz, DSD64-1024 DoP/Raw, and hardware volume control
    • Bit Perfect Modes - intended for DAPs/USB DACs; supported for Hi-Res, USB Exclusive, and partially AAudio
      • Follow Track: dynamically reconfigures to match the track's sample rate
      • Perfect Bit Perfect: disables DSP, gains, and crossfade to send decoded audio (including DSD) directly to the output
      • 64-bit Pipeline: extends internal format to Float64 for bit-lossless processing or increased DSP accuracy
      • DSD Remastering: converts audio to DSD64-1024, with or without PCM-domain DSP (can be combined with Perfect Bit Perfect mode)
    • Hi-Res Output native/DoP DSD64-1024 support
    • Dynamic Reconfiguration: quickly reconfigures engine on routing/codec changes instead of full reloading
  • Audio Outputs settings improvements:
    • simplified settings hierarchy with shortened Device ➔ Options navigation
    • new sample rate, format, DSD, and other advanced options for USB Exclusive and Hi-Res outputs
    • per-output Follow Track, Perfect Bit Perfect, 64-bit Pipeline, DSD Remastering options - where supported
    • Allowed Sample Rates option which enables/disables specific sample rates for the given output
    • Base-Rate Synchronous Scaling option which enables sample rate change within same 44K/48K-base family
    • DSD Remastering Target DSD Sample Rate and Allow 48 kHz-based DSD options
    • USB Exclusive: Volume Type and Synchronize Hardware Volume options; Release USB DAC while paused, Allow DSD DOP, Prefer DSD Raw, Warmup on Startup, Force USB 1.1 options
    • Show Poweramp for USB DACs option, allowing future connections without a confirmation dialog
    • custom profiles for USB and Bluetooth devices
    • Bluetooth codec sample rate matching
    • new Set BT Codec Parameters option which dynamically changes Codec sample rate/format
      AAudio (recommended) and Hi-Res Outputs
      Android 9+
      Some phones (e.g., Samsungs) may not allow codec sample rate to be switched this way; others (e.g., Xiaomis), may not allow specific formats/sample rates, etc.
    • output related Advanced Tweaks moved to Audio Output ➔ Advanced Tweaks
    • new Show Poweramp for USB DACs option
  • preamp range increased to -24..+24dB
    Helps with bass EQ on DAPs
  • FFmpeg updated to 8.1.1
  • Webm format support
  • Wired Headset/AUX is renamed to Wired 3.5/4.4 mm for DAPs
  • more accurate display of DSD rates
  • updated/improved Hi-Res output support for DAPs: A&K, Cayin, iBasso, HiBy, FiiO, Shanling, Sony, Tempotec
  • Audio Info dialog is updated for the new Audio Engine features and provides Fidelity and Processing scores
  • Limit button is now highlighted when overload is detected
  • new Pause On USB DAC connection option
  • rescan in folder scans just that folder (and subfolders)
  • skin authors now have protection/optional verification for their skins
  • all new features and options of this update are included into the base app and don't require Feature Package purchase. If you enjoy the update, you can always support us by purchasing Uberpatron badges
"

  • new Background Gradient, Background Gradient Color, Background Gradient For Lists options

" Builds 978-988:
  • introducing 🎁 Feature Packages:
    • the number of big and small features (user requested/voted on Poweramp forum) packed together into low priced in-app purchase
    • a few packages per year
    • new features added to the same package with the each new build
    • new Full Version purchase includes feature package discount
    • this helps with Poweramp app continued development

🎁 Feature package #1:
  • support for multiple items dragging in playlists and Queue
    Multiple checked items are dragged as a group
  • new Line2 Press and Line2 Long Press options
  • new Hide Unknown Artist option
    Unknown Artist is hidden from track labels in Poweramp UI as possible
  • new Animations option
    Navigation animations now can be faster or disabled
  • more features for this package in the next builds

"

" Builds 989-991:
  • new Hide System Bars For Full Screen option
    🎁 Feature Pack #1
  • new Menu Button Long Press option
    🎁 Feature Pack #1
  • new cast option: Show Meta Information
  • Info/Tags now shows total played count, including playbacks from the count-based or count-sorted categories
    As previously, the track sorting or standing within such categories is not changed by playback from these
  • added workaround to support DVC on the specific Android 15 firmwares (Pixel 9 series, Samsungs S25) via Compensate DVC Volume option
  • Poweramp now can indicate inability to detect Absolute Volume
    • on some Android 15 devices it's not possible to detect Absolute Volume. Poweramp now assumes Absolute Volume is enabled and disables DVC when No DVC for Bluetooth Absolute Volume option is checked
    • please uncheck this option if you know Absolute Volume is disabled on your device
    • DVC settings page changed to describe the DVC+Absolute Volume functionality better
  • Android 15 restricts access to BT codec information - app won't be always able to show the codec, but still tries to show sample rate/bits
  • Google Cast for Audio (GC4A) 2.0 support
"

Also:
  • improved reshuffle for the large (>10k) lists
  • improved very large lists (>20k items) scrolling performance
  • improved mod files scanning performance
  • improved FLAC metadata parsing
  • increased number of Sleep timer possible values
  • audio routing detection code revamp
    Improved Poweramp detection of the complicated routing changes such as between multiple BT devices
  • improved tag handling of the files with the incorrect extensions (such as a mp4 file with the mp3 extension)
  • .oga, flac in .ogg/.oga support
  • fixed Repeat One in CUE
  • other small changes for Android 15
  • Target SDK updated to 35
  • simplified Full Version unlocking via in-app purchase for Play
    Unlocker app continues to be available on Play for those who previously purchased it

" Builds 992-996:
  • Add to Playlist dialog improvements via selectable modes:
    • Add to single playlist – quickly add songs with a single click to one playlist (duplicates are possible if enabled in Settings)
    • Add – add songs to one or multiple playlists (duplicates are possible if enabled)
    • Toggle – applicable to a single song only. Quickly overview if a song is in playlists and toggle the song in and out (no duplicates)
    • Modes are stored per the selection type – for the single or multiple tracks
  • if file access is removed by the user (via (i)->Storage & cache->Clear access) or by Android (via Manage app if unused), Poweramp now keeps the Library entries intact
    • previously, a normal scan removed inaccessible entries from the Library
    • Full Rescan still removes all inaccessible entries from the Library
    • Poweramp now suggests restoring the missing permissions
    • It's recommended to disable Manage app if unused option for Poweramp as it may suddenly remove the access to files, even if the app is actively used (for example, due to some firmware update)
  • Bold+ font for Settings
  • implemented Audio Focus Duck Volume for the AAudio output
  • improved resuming and pausing after an audio focus change/call for some devices/firmwares
  • improved audio output detection when voice assistant (Gemini) is used
  • improved Resume on Bluetooth for some devices/firmwares
  • new Beep More option
  • improved compatibility with the old 3rd party skins
  • improved sleep timer
  • improved Bluetooth double/triple button presses for some devices/firmwares
  • updated translations

"

" Builds 997-999:
  • 16kb page size support
    Google Play requirement
  • battery, CPU usage, app size optimizations
  • Poweramp may now detect remote-submix (for example, Android Auto) as Other output type
  • enabled Hi-Res output for Android 15+ devices
    • useful for the subset of Android 15+ devices which do not support Hi-Res via AAudio
    • AAudio output is recommended for the devices where Hi-Res works with AAudio
  • updated WavPack decoder
  • AutoEq presets/devices database update
    15199 presets updated
  • new Strict Resume/Pause/Stop option
    Use for headunits/devices generating stray play/pause/stop key press commands, which are interpreted as undesired playback toggle or double press
  • improved playlist entries resolution
    Entries now matched against greater range of sub-paths, and just by filename - in playlist parent folder when appropriate
  • bug fixes and stability improvements
  • updated translations
